ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a large right-triangle grid composed of small right triangles, with A at the upper-left vertex and B at the lower-right vertex. Each right-angle side of the large triangle is divided into 4 small units; from A to B, one can only go along grid edges downward, rightward, or along the hypotenuse of a small triangle toward the lower right. The arrows in the small diagram also indicate these three allowed directions. Reasoning: Represent the grid points as coordinates (i,j), where i represents the number of steps to the right and j represents the number of steps downward. Since the point must remain inside the triangle, 0 <= i <= j <= 4. The allowed moves are downward (0,1), rightward (1,0), and diagonal lower-right (1,1). Let f(i,j) be the number of paths from A=(0,0) to (i,j), then f(0,0)=1, and f(i,j)=f(i,j-1)+f(i-1,j)+f(i-1,j-1); terms that are out of bounds or not inside the triangle are not counted. Row-by-row calculation: j=1: 1, 2 j=2: 1, 4, 6 j=3: 1, 6, 16, 22 j=4: 1, 8, 30, 68, 90 B corresponds to (4,4), so the number of paths is f(4,4)=90.

raw_record.question_text: How many different ways can you follow from point $A$ to point $B$ if you can go only down, right, or down diagonally by the sides of small triangles?

method.method_draft: Model the diagram as a directed lattice graph. From the image, read that the large right triangle is subdivided into a triangular grid of side length 4: starting at A at the top-left corner and ending at B at the bottom-right corner, the usable lattice points can be coordinatized as (i,j) with 0 <= i <= j <= 4, where i is the number of right steps and j is the number of down steps. The small diagonal edges all run down-right, so the allowed moves from the text correspond to (0,1), (1,0), and (1,1). Let f(i,j) be the number of ways to reach point (i,j) while staying inside the triangular grid. Set f(0,0)=1 and use the recurrence f(i,j)=f(i,j-1)+f(i-1,j)+f(i-1,j-1), omitting terms outside the region i<=j. Fill the triangular table row by row up to (4,4): row j=1 gives 1,2; row j=2 gives 1,4,6; row j=3 gives 1,6,16,22; row j=4 gives 1,8,30,68,90. Therefore f(4,4)=90.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个由小直角三角形组成的大直角三角形网格，A 在左上顶点，B 在右下顶点。大三角形每条直角边被分成 4 个小单位；从 A 到 B 只能沿网格边向下、向右，或沿小三角形的斜边向右下走。小图中的箭头也标明了这三种允许方向。

推理：把网格点表示为坐标 (i,j)，其中 i 表示向右的步数，j 表示向下的步数。由于点必须留在三角形内部，所以 0 <= i <= j <= 4。允许的移动是向下 (0,1)、向右 (1,0)、向右下斜走 (1,1)。设 f(i,j) 为从 A=(0,0) 到达 (i,j) 的路径数，则 f(0,0)=1，并且
f(i,j)=f(i,j-1)+f(i-1,j)+f(i-1,j-1)，越界或不在三角形内的项不计。

逐行计算：
j=1: 1, 2
j=2: 1, 4, 6
j=3: 1, 6, 16, 22
j=4: 1, 8, 30, 68, 90

B 对应 (4,4)，所以路径数为 f(4,4)=90。
